location.en: Your studio apartment on Cedar Street

goal.en: Go through the move-out inspection with Mr. Lin and get your deposit back.
goal.zh: 和林先生完成退租點交，順利拿回押金。

background: small empty studio apartment, bare walls with a few tiny nail holes, clean wooden floor, old radiator heater under the window, plain taped cardboard boxes by the door, morning light

intro.en: Moving day. Your whole year fits into four boxes and one suitcase. Mia has offered you her couch for your last few nights.
intro.zh: 搬家日。你一整年的生活，裝進了四個紙箱和一個行李箱。米亞讓你最後幾晚睡她家沙發。

intro.en: Mr. Lin arrives exactly on time, clipboard in hand.
intro.zh: 林先生準時抵達，手上拿著寫字板。

intro.en: Morning, Kai. Shall we do the move-out inspection?
intro.zh: 早安，凱。我們來做退租點交吧？

lines.en: Let's start. Is everything the way it was when you moved in?
lines.zh: 開始吧。一切都跟你搬進來時一樣嗎？

choices.en: Mostly. There's some normal wear and tear, but it's all clean.
choices.zh: 大致上是。有一些正常的使用耗損，但都打掃乾淨了。
choices.tip: wear and tear 是「正常使用造成的耗損」，退租時主動說明，顯得誠實又專業。

choices.en: Almost the same. Some parts look a bit old, but I did a big cleaning.
choices.zh: 差不多一樣。有些地方看起來有點舊，但我大掃除過了。

lines.en: A big cleaning? You mean a deep clean? Hmm. We'll see.
lines.zh: A big cleaning？你是說徹底清潔吧？嗯，我們看看。

story.en: Mr. Lin checks every corner extra carefully, just to see how big your cleaning really was.
story.zh: 林先生把每個角落都檢查得特別仔細，就為了看看你的「大」掃除到底有多大。

fail.why: 「大掃除」英文說 a deep clean 或 a thorough cleaning。「正常耗損」則是 wear and tear。

choices.en: Of course. It's perfect, so you really don't need to check anything.
choices.zh: 當然，完美無缺，所以您根本不需要檢查。

lines.en: I'll be the judge of that, thank you.

story.en: Nothing makes a landlord check harder than "no need to check." Mr. Lin even inspects the inside of the fridge door.
story.zh: 對房東來說，沒有什麼比「不用檢查」更讓人想檢查。林先生連冰箱門內側都看了。

fail.why: 叫房東不用檢查聽起來像在隱瞞。退租點交是正常流程，坦白說明現況就好：There's some normal wear and tear.。

lines.en: Hmm. What about these small holes in the wall here?
lines.zh: 嗯，那牆上這幾個小洞呢？

choices.en: Those are from hanging photos. I'm happy to fill them before I go.
choices.zh: 那是掛照片留下的。我很樂意在走之前補好。
choices.tip: 說明原因後主動提出補救（I'm happy to...），能減少押金被扣的機會。

choices.en: Those are from hanging photo. I can to fill them up before I leave.
choices.zh: 那是掛照片的。我走之前可以把它們補起來。

lines.en: You "can to" fill them? So... can you, or can't you?
lines.zh: You can to fill？所以……你到底會不會補？

story.en: Mr. Lin isn't sure what you promised, so he writes "repair cost" on his clipboard, just in case.
story.zh: 林先生不確定你承諾了什麼，就先在寫字板上記下「修繕費」，以防萬一。

fail.why: 助動詞 can 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to：I can fill them.。photo 是可數名詞，多張要用複數 photos。

choices.en: Those were already there. Maybe the last tenant did it, not me?
choices.zh: 那些本來就在了。可能是上一個房客弄的，不是我吧？

lines.en: I took photos on your move-in day, Kai. They weren't there.
lines.zh: 你搬進來那天我拍了照，凱。那時候沒有這些洞。

story.en: Mr. Lin shows you the photos, one by one. The holes cost you nothing. Your honesty costs you a lot more.
story.zh: 林先生一張一張給你看照片。那些洞不值什麼錢，但你的誠信損失大多了。

fail.why: 推給前房客很容易被拆穿，房東通常有入住時的照片。坦白說明並提出補救：I'm happy to fill them.。

lines.en: Good. And the heater? It broke down on you once, didn't it?
lines.zh: 好。那暖氣呢？它之前壞過一次，對吧？

choices.en: It works fine now. You fixed it fast, and I really appreciated that.
choices.zh: 現在運作正常。您當時很快就修好了，我真的很感謝。
choices.tip: 點交時順便感謝房東過去的協助，讓氣氛更好，也是好的告別。

choices.en: Now no problem. When it broke last time, I almost frozen to die in here.
choices.zh: 現在沒問題了。上次壞掉的時候，我差點在這裡冷死。

lines.en: Frozen to die? Well, you seem very alive to me.
lines.zh: Frozen to die？嗯，你看起來活得好好的。

story.en: Mr. Lin feels a little guilty and a little confused. He checks the heater twice, just in case it tries to freeze the next tenant.
story.zh: 林先生有點愧疚又有點困惑。他把暖氣檢查了兩次，免得下一個房客也被「冷死」。

fail.why: 「冷死了」英文說 I was freezing. 或 I almost froze.，不說 frozen to die。「現在沒問題」是 It works fine now.。

choices.en: Speaking of cold weather, do you know any good places to ski near here?
choices.zh: 說到天冷，您知道這附近有什麼好的滑雪場嗎？

lines.en: You're leaving this week, Kai. And the heater?
lines.zh: 你這週就要走了，凱。暖氣呢？

story.en: Mr. Lin recommends two ski resorts, then remembers he never got an answer about the heater. He tests it himself, slowly.
story.zh: 林先生推薦了兩個滑雪場，然後想起你還沒回答暖氣的事。他只好自己慢慢測試。

fail.why: 點交時房東問設備狀況，要直接回答，不要岔題：It works fine now.。

lines.en: All right. Everything looks acceptable. Any questions before I sign?
lines.zh: 好。一切看起來都沒問題。簽名前還有什麼問題嗎？

choices.en: Just one. When can I expect to get my deposit back?
choices.zh: 只有一個。押金大概什麼時候可以退還給我？
choices.tip: When can I expect...? 是有禮貌地詢問時程的說法；get my deposit back 是「拿回押金」。

choices.en: Just one. When will my deposit return back to my bank account?
choices.zh: 只有一個。我的押金什麼時候會退回到我的銀行帳戶？

lines.en: Your deposit will "return back" by itself? I wish money did that.
lines.zh: 你的押金會自己「回回來」？我也希望錢會這樣。

story.en: Mr. Lin explains that he has to send it. He takes his time. It feels like a lesson.
story.zh: 林先生解釋押金得由他匯，不會自己飛回去。他不疾不徐，感覺像在上課。

fail.why: return 本身就有「回」的意思，加 back 是重複。而且押金不會自己回去，要說 When can I get my deposit back?

choices.en: Yes. You're giving me the full deposit back, right? Every dollar?
choices.zh: 有。您會把押金全額退給我吧？一塊都不少？

lines.en: If you keep asking like that, I'll check the oven too.
lines.zh: 你再這樣問，我連烤箱都要檢查了。

story.en: Mr. Lin checks the oven. You did not clean the oven. Twenty dollars disappear from your deposit.
story.zh: 林先生檢查了烤箱。你沒清烤箱。押金少了二十塊。

fail.why: 語氣像在逼問，會讓房東覺得你不信任他。有禮貌地詢問時程：When can I expect to get my deposit back?

lines.en: Within two weeks. The full amount.
You were a good tenant, Kai. Quiet, clean, polite. I'll miss that.
lines.zh: 你是個好房客，凱。安靜、愛乾淨、有禮貌。我會懷念的。

choices.en: Thanks, Mr. Lin. You were strict but always fair. I'll miss this place.
choices.zh: 謝謝您，林先生。您很嚴格，但一直很公平。我會想念這裡的。
choices.tip: strict but fair 是對長輩、上司很好的讚美：肯定對方的原則，也肯定對方的公正。

choices.en: Thank you! Let me take you to dinner tonight. I insist, you can't say no!
choices.zh: 謝謝！今晚讓我請您吃飯，我堅持，您不能拒絕！

lines.en: I... appreciate it, but I have plans. Really. I do.
lines.zh: 我……很感謝，但我真的有約了。真的。

story.en: You insist three more times. Mr. Lin leaves quickly, waving his clipboard like a shield.
story.zh: 你又堅持了三次。林先生拿著寫字板像盾牌一樣揮著，快步離開了。

fail.why: 中文的「我堅持、不准拒絕」是客套，但在英語文化中對方說 no 通常就是真的 no，一直堅持會讓人有壓力。真誠道謝就好。

choices.en: Thank you for taking care of me this year, Mr. Lin. You worked hard!
choices.zh: 謝謝您這一年的照顧，林先生。您辛苦了！

lines.en: Worked hard? Kai, I mostly just collected the rent.
lines.zh: 辛苦？凱，我大部分時間只是收房租而已。

story.en: Mr. Lin laughs for the first time all year. It's a nice moment, even if the compliment completely missed.
story.zh: 林先生今年第一次笑出聲。雖然讚美完全沒打中，這一刻還是很美好。

fail.why: 「您辛苦了」直譯 You worked hard! 在英文裡很奇怪，英文沒有完全對應的說法。改成具體感謝：Thank you for everything. 或 You were always fair.。

lines.en: If you ever come back to Maple Bay, my door is open. For a visit. Not a rent discount.
lines.zh: 如果你回楓灣，我家的門隨時為你開著。是來拜訪，不是來討房租折扣。

lines.en: You hand over the keys. The empty studio looks smaller than you remember.
lines.zh: 你交還鑰匙。空蕩蕩的套房，看起來比你記憶中小。

story.en: Honest answers, small repairs and a sincere thank-you. You leave with your full deposit and a landlord who will actually miss you.
story.zh: 誠實的回答、小小的修補，加上真心的道謝。你拿回全額押金，還有一位真的會想念你的房東。

notes.explain: 退租時房東和房客一起檢查房屋狀況，決定押金是否扣款。入住時對應的是 move-in inspection。

example.en: The move-out inspection is on Saturday at ten.
example.zh: 退租點交在星期六十點。

notes.explain: 指房屋或物品因日常使用自然產生的磨損，通常不會從押金扣款。人為損壞則是 damage。

example.en: Faded curtains are normal wear and tear.
example.zh: 窗簾褪色屬於正常耗損。

notes.en: When can I expect to get my deposit back?
notes.zh: 押金大概什麼時候可以退還？
notes.explain: When can I expect...? 是禮貌詢問時程的句型，比 When will you give me...? 委婉。

example.en: When can I expect a reply?
example.zh: 我大概什麼時候可以收到回覆？

notes.explain: return 本身就是「回來、歸還」，加 back 是重複。同類錯誤還有 repeat again、enter into the room。

example.en: Please return the keys by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前歸還鑰匙。

notes.explain: 「您辛苦了」和「我堅持請客」在英文裡都沒有直接對應。英語文化重視具體的感謝，對方說 no 也要尊重，不必一再堅持。

example.en: Thank you for everything. You were always fair to me.
example.zh: 謝謝您的照顧，您一直對我很公平。
